R26 steady-state safety replay plus classification rejection causes large draw amplification and contributes to headset stutter.
Recovery runtime forcing 60 FPS with interpolation/cadence disabled contributes independent judder on a 90 Hz OpenXR session.
Restore fast R29 world rendering and classification in bounded variants before deciding which later R30-R34 overlays are required.
